summary: Build platform roadmaps, API briefs, and KPI scorecards in 5 days. Learn practical product methods for technical delivery teams.
lede: Platform and API product management brings user needs, business goals, and technical constraints into product decisions. This course is for platform, API, and technical product managers and product owners coordinating across product, engineering, and business teams. It develops skills in discovering API consumer needs, prioritizing roadmaps with MoSCoW and Kano, and managing API lifecycles, governance, launches, and adoption metrics.
audienceIntro: This platform and API product management training is built for professionals who need to define platform value, prioritize API investments, and coordinate delivery across product, engineering, and business teams.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of product management, software delivery, or digital service operations. Familiarity with Agile concepts, REST API basics, and standard product artefacts such as roadmaps or user stories will help, but deep programming experience is not required. A laptop is recommended for the practical exercises, and prior exposure to API testing tools such as Postman will support faster engagement with the labs.
